spec.title: Block Number
spec.description: This metric is always emitted. If it's not, it means the process stopped.

spec.title: Price Delta % of Arbitrage
spec.description: Positive numbers represent we would profit and are quoting as expected. Negative numbers represent bad fills. This should only happen in rare edge cases.

spec.title: Balances (USD)
spec.description: These are the balances in multiple coins. For now, this does not take into account accumulated fee incentives for the order fills. Gas fees are also tracked in another panel.

spec.title: Flip Balance (gas fees)
spec.description: This balance represents the FLIP amount for paying gas fees.

spec.title: Price and Quotes (tick)
spec.description: Each tick represents 1bp in the Chainflip pool.

spec.query: SELECT last("spread_within_200_bps") FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_test" WHERE ("pool"::tag =~ /^$Pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.title: Order Quote Amounts (USD)
spec.description:
Configured to be between a small range (e.g. 11K-12.5K) and most of the time they should be at the higher end. 

While not too useful right now, in the future, if a 2-layer solution is implemented, this panel would be pretty useful.

spec.title: Theoretical (Fake) Daily PnL
spec.description: This shows the theoretical PnL of the strategy if we were to hedge. Currently, we DO NOT hedge. Hence, this is fake PnL solely used for understanding how well the strategy is doing vs speculation.

spec.query: SELECT mean("price_pnl_usd") FROM "default_defi_retention"."chainflip_test" WHERE ("pool"::tag =~ /^$Pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
